title: Registered anatomical body surface, musculature and skeleton
creator: Z-Anatomy contributors; BodyParts3D / Anatomography, DBCLS
coordinateSystem: glTF metres: +Y up, +Z anterior, anatomical left +X
modifications: Removed annotation geometry, muscle attachment visualizers, fascia/bursae/sheaths, and auditory ossicles.
Kept exact external body-surface territory triangles; removed Skin-in interior backing faces.
Uniformly normalized complete registered assembly to 1.8 m body-surface height and translated soles to floor.
Adaptively decimated internal musculature and skeleton with sampled surface-distance checks; no remeshing or shape fitting.
Baked original world transforms once per independent mesh; reversed face winding for negative-determinant source instances to retain outward orientation.
Recolored materials in natural tissue hues, retaining original tendon face assignments through vertex colors.
limitations: Source is a generic registered anatomical atlas, not a personalized medical scan.
Surface-distance checks sample up to 200 source vertices per object, one direction only; not a global Hausdorff bound.
Rig landmarks and simulated exercise motion are educational approximations and not clinically validated biomechanics.
